TulsaConnect's Downtown Tulsa facility (DC-5) is a locally owned data center in downtown Tulsa, Oklahoma. No IT load, power capacity, or cooling specifications are published for this site. The operator's own website does not state which services or certifications this facility holds.

Oklahoma has nine mapped data center facilities total, but none publish power capacity figures. This facility's published specifications are empty, so it cannot be ranked against other sites by megawatts or by any measure of AI infrastructure readiness. The state context note indicates most mapped facilities in Oklahoma publish no figures at all.

This campus does not appear in any published dataset about grid constraints on AI scaling, because no capacity data is available. Without power capacity, cooling specifications, or electrical grid details from the operator, the facility cannot be evaluated as a factor in AI compute availability.
